says: In today's CI, the related legs' checklist faults step runs whenever a pull request changes next/apps/fabrika/src/checklist-instance.laws.integration.test.ts, and it accepts that file only byte-identical to its catalog commit 3ca406a62, so no lint fill can touch the file while the plant cases pin it, and next/apps/fabrika cannot reach zero for a rule the file breaks: it holds 11 require-safety-comment-for-type-assertion hits and one prefer-effect-match hit that 0561 and 0567 ask to fix.
proof: .github/ci/plant-related.ts:39-45 (`wanted`) starts the step when the fixture is among the changed paths, and :358-366 compares the fixture's bytes with `git show ${catalog}:${file}` and fails `automatic_catalog_image` on any difference. On pull request 1593 at eb03c11ce the fold's edits to the fixture started the step (https://github.com/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/actions/runs/44227565963/job/134546373799). It stopped earlier, with `automatic_metadata`, as a comment on the pull request reports: its pinned commits a062f7a25 and 3ca406a62 are not in main's history (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` fails for both), since their branch was squash-merged. The lead first wrote, wrongly, that the byte check was what failed here; it is the check the step would meet next. The file was put back to main's bytes in 382323d29, and next/apps/fabrika left those two rules' lock blocks in 855c47fc2.
cost: One folder of next/ stays off two lint locks while the plant catalog pins the fixture, and every sweep that edits the file starts a step that fails with no message in its log. If https://github.com/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/pull/1569 or decision 0600 drops or re-pins those cases, the fixture's 12 hits can be fixed and the folder locked.
